rationale: Tests understanding of global developmental delay definition and domain classification from the Clinical Presentation block
Applies the systematic diagnostic approach including the mandatory screen for treatable metabolic causes covered in the Approach to Diagnosis block
Tests understanding of the CDU multidisciplinary assessment process and what different team members contribute, from the CDU Assessment Process block
Tests understanding of CDU's integrated interpretation and referral role from the Applied Observation block
Applies DSM-5 diagnostic criteria for ADHD — specifically the multi-setting requirement and age-of-onset criterion — from the Diagnosis of ADHD block
Tests recall of first-line pharmacotherapy for ADHD in children and the role of multimodal management from the Management of ADHD block
Tests understanding of DSM-5 two-domain ASD definition and the specific features that distinguish ASD from a language disorder, from the Clinical Presentation block
Tests recall of the M-CHAT-R/F as the recommended early screening tool for ASD and its appropriate age range, from the Diagnosis of ASD block
